LanguageData.WTS_CommandScoutDesc: Begin remote scouting of this tile. After one day, receive an expected force summary from site threat patterns (faction roster, mechanoids, manhunters, anomaly, etc.).
LanguageData.WTS_CommandViewIntelDesc: Open the stored scouting summary for this tile.
LanguageData.WTS_ScoutStarted: Scouting {0}. Report expected in one day.
LanguageData.WTS_ScoutFailedGone: Scouting of {0} failed — the target is gone.
LanguageData.WTS_ScoutFailedChanged: Scouting of {0} failed — site data changed during observation.
LanguageData.WTS_LetterText:
Scouting of {0} is finished.

You now have an expected force summary (combat mix, gear samples when relevant, kinds).

Open the attached report before deciding whether to raid.
LanguageData.WTS_Fail_NoHostiles: Only non-player inhabited sites can be scouted.
LanguageData.WTS_Fail_NoRosterData: This faction has no usable roster data.
LanguageData.WTS_Fail_NoInhabitants: No scoutable threat signals on this site.
LanguageData.WTS_Fail_Unsupported: This world object cannot be scouted.
LanguageData.WTS_ReportDisclaimer: Expected roster from site threat patterns / PawnGroupMaker examples. Not a live map scan.
LanguageData.WTS_ReportDisclaimerSpecial: Estimated threat pattern — may omit delayed ambushes or post-arrival spawns. Not a live ESP.
LanguageData.WTS_ModeDistressCall: Distress / anomaly pattern: camp faction usually dead; primary living threat from entities (fleshbeasts), not the signal faction roster.
LanguageData.WTS_ModeManhunters: Manhunter pack pattern: aggressive animals from site animal kind / points.
LanguageData.WTS_ModeSleepingMechanoids: Sleeping mechanoids pattern: Mechanoid combat group from threat points.
LanguageData.WTS_ModeMechCluster: Mech cluster pattern: mechanoid combat estimate from threat points (not the site faction).
LanguageData.WTS_ModeMechanoidRelay: Mechanoid relay pattern: mechanoid presence estimated from threat points.
LanguageData.WTS_ModeInsects: Insect lair pattern: insect combat group from threat points.
LanguageData.WTS_ModeTurrets: Turret site pattern: automated defenses plus possible faction guards.
LanguageData.WTS_ModeWorkSite: Work site pattern: workers and fighters from faction doctrine.
LanguageData.WTS_ModeConditionCauser: Condition-causer site: primary threat is the structure/condition, not a pawn roster.
LanguageData.WTS_ModeComplex: Ancient complex pattern: layout threats; roster approximate if available.
LanguageData.WTS_ModeAmbush: Ambush / hidden threat: composition is deferred until map entry — points only.
LanguageData.WTS_ModeAbandoned: Abandoned settlement pattern: no living faction defenders expected from gen steps.
LanguageData.WTS_ModeUnknown: Unrecognized site threat pattern — showing points-based / empty estimate.
